## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug returns at least one bug filed during the a34c sprint that carries a detected_by:<channel> tag from the seven allowed values

File one real bug ticket against the a34c sprint epic using the ticket CLI directly:

  .claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug "<short title describing a real defect observed during the a34c sprint>" --parent a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 --tags CLI_user --tags detected_by:tests --priority 3 --description "<reproduction steps, expected vs actual>"

Choose a real, observed defect from the sprint — not a synthetic placeholder. If no fresh defect is available, escalate to the orchestrator before fabricating one. The ticket id returned is the proof artifact; record it in the task completion comment.

Also create RED test tests/scripts/test-a34c-real-bug-exists.sh that invokes the ticket CLI and asserts at least one bug under the a34c epic carries a detected_by:<channel> tag from the seven allowed values.

## Testing Mode
RED — write the existence test first; it fails because no qualified bug exists yet. Then file the real bug to make it pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- At least one real bug ticket exists under epic a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 — Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug --parent=a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 | python3 -c "import json,sys; bugs=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if bugs else 1)"
- That bug carries a detected_by:<channel> tag from the seven allowed values — Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug --parent=a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 | python3 -c "import json,sys,re; bugs=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if any(any(re.match(r'detected_by:(tests|review-llm|review-human|production|user-report|internal-dogfood|other)', t) for t in b.get('tags',[])) for b in bugs) else 1)"
- RED test exists and passes — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-a34c-real-bug-exists.sh
- RED test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-a34c-real-bug-exists.sh
- Test handles absence-of-bug failure mode (non-zero exit when no qualifying bug exists) — Verify: grep -Eq 'exit 1|return 1|FAIL' tests/scripts/test-a34c-real-bug-exists.sh

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-a34c-real-bug-exists.sh — Create
data.title: File one real a34c sprint bug ticket with detected_by:tests tag
